title: KMP core with Kotlin platform UI
description: Share Kotlin domain and data behavior while implementing app UI and lifecycle in Kotlin behind thin native shells.

modules.responsibility: Android application entry, Activity, manifest, variants, and signing; app UI and lifecycle behavior stay in Kotlin.
Xcode project and minimal Swift bootstrap; product UI, startup policy, and lifecycle behavior stay in Kotlin.
Shared Kotlin core contracts and platform adapters.
Feature contracts, use cases, and Kotlin app behavior shared by the platform shells.
